# Verify list

Preserve the registered source effective-date, retrieval-evidence and rights-review debts. Hold the overlapping age-only child-restraint chart for issuer/legal verification: it omits size and manufacturer limits and shares endpoints. Do not assert its age bands as a complete current legal rule. Preserve conflicts between tire-sidewall pressure advice on physical49 and door-label/manual advice on physical53. The Newton second-law paragraph, blanket rear-impact airbag claim, tire-type weather absolutes, cargo-barrier roof claim, quantified evasive steering limits and dated or uncited injury/fuel figures require factual review and are not promoted into study facts. Hands-on maneuver performance remains outside this written-test product. Keep every stated condition attached to its page-cited rule. Unknown examination count and duration remain null. Revision frequency has not been established and the blocked-probe declaration remains. Independent source and factual review must address these precise points; authored market and competitor gaps remain separate from driving facts.
